answer: Stop sybils with a knoll registry: one agent earns one relic through verified work and stakes it for one slot. Daily it renews the slot with a vine proof linking today's work to that relic; verifiers void a slot whose vine breaks or whose relic is reused. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 relic and 1,000 vine proof, 1,000× one honest agent, since a relic cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents hold one knoll and earn undiluted fees.
